Stock market news | Gold slips as Fed outlook fuels tariff concerns

Gold prices fell sharply on 25 November 2026, erasing most of the rebound seen on Monday.

The drop follows bets on further US rate hikes and a tariff-driven equity rout, prompting some traders to sell gold to cover losses.
